name: claudechain
description: Self-analyzing code chain engine: ingest a repository into typed, queryable objects, and halt when it finds itself.

scripts.analyze: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node dist/cli/bin.js analyze
scripts.self: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node dist/cli/bin.js self
